title: Affordance Tags V1.5
description: Actionable properties of a visual object, inferred from its geometry, orientation and spatial context: the types of physical or semantic action that the object invites.

Pushable.description: Object can be pushed or activated via force.

Openable.description: Object can be opened or revealed.

Draggable.description: Object can be moved across a surface.

Tappable.description: Object can be tapped for interaction.

Selectable.description: Object can be selected or highlighted.

Liftable.description: Object can be picked up or elevated.

Insertable.description: Object can be placed into another object or container.

Activatable.description: Object triggers a function or state change when interacted with.
